title: quarkus-jgit: Cannot save config file 'FileBasedConfig[/project/?/.gitconfig]': java.io.IOException: Creating directories for /project/? failed
body:
**Describe the bug**
When a directory is cloned to a directory that does not exist using the JGit API, the following error is shown in the logs when the application runs in native mode: 

```java
2019-09-26 02:12:40,738 ERROR [org.ecl.jgi.uti.FS] (ForkJoinPool.commonPool-worker-1) Cannot save config file 'FileBasedConfig[/project/?/.gitconfig]': java.io.IOException: Creating directories for /project/? failed
	at org.eclipse.jgit.util.FileUtils.mkdirs(FileUtils.java:425)
	at org.eclipse.jgit.internal.storage.file.LockFile.lock(LockFile.java:163)
	at org.eclipse.jgit.storage.file.FileBasedConfig.save(FileBasedConfig.java:252)
	at org.eclipse.jgit.util.FS$FileStoreAttributes.saveToConfig(FS.java:584)
	at org.eclipse.jgit.util.FS$FileStoreAttributes.lambda$0(FS.java:364)
	at java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture$AsyncSupply.run(CompletableFuture.java:1590)
	at java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture$AsyncSupply.exec(CompletableFuture.java:1582)
	at java.util.concurrent.ForkJoinTask.doExec(ForkJoinTask.java:289)
	at java.util.concurrent.ForkJoinPool$WorkQueue.runTask(ForkJoinPool.java:1056)
	at java.util.concurrent.ForkJoinPool.runWorker(ForkJoinPool.java:1692)
	at java.util.concurrent.ForkJoinWorkerThread.run(ForkJoinWorkerThread.java:157)
	at com.oracle.svm.core.thread.JavaThreads.threadStartRoutine(JavaThreads.java:460)
	at com.oracle.svm.core.posix.thread.PosixJavaThreads.pthreadStartRoutine(PosixJavaThreads.java:193)
```

The warning seems harmless, because the directory is cloned successfully.

**Expected behavior**
No stacktrace

**Actual behavior**
Stacktrace is shown in the logs. Invocation still works

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1.  Go to code.quarkus.io and choose the JGit extension
2. Change the JAX-RS Resource to do something like:
```java
    @GET
    @Produces(MediaType.TEXT_PLAIN)
    public String hello() {
        try (Git git = Git.cloneRepository()
                                .setURI("https://github.com/gastaldi/ceaseless-card")
                                .setDirectory(new File("/tmp", "foo"))
                                .call()) {
                        
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
              // ignore
        }
        return "hello";
    }
```
3. Build a native image with `mvn package -Pnative -Dnative-image.docker-build -DskipTests`
4. Run the native image with SSL enabled (https://quarkus.io/guides/native-and-ssl-guide#the-sunec-library-and-friends): 

```bash
$ target/code-with-quarkus-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT-runner -Djava.library.path=/home/ggastald/.sdkman/candidates/java/19.2.0.1-grl/jre/lib/amd64 -Djavax.net.ssl.trustStore=/home/ggastald/.sdkman/candidates/java/19.2.0.1-grl/jre/lib/security
```
5. Go to http://localhost:8080/hello and see the stacktrace in the logs. The clone command works though.

**Configuration**
```properties
# Add your application.properties here, if applicable.

```

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - Output of `uname -a` or `ver`:  `Linux ggastald-laptop 5.2.15-200.fc30.x86_64 #1 SMP Mon Sep 16 15:17:36 UTC 2019 x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux`
 - Output of `java -version`: 
```
openjdk version "1.8.0_212"
OpenJDK Runtime Environment (AdoptOpenJDK)(build 1.8.0_212-b03)
OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM (AdoptOpenJDK)(build 25.212-b03, mixed mode)
```
 - GraalVM version (if different from Java): 19.0.2.1
 - Quarkus version or git rev: 0.23.1

**Additional context**
(Add any other context about the problem here.)

The error does not appear in JVM mode.
